add_definitions(
    -D_CRT_NON_CONFORMING_SWPRINTFS
    -D_WINE)

spec2def(mpr.dll mpr.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# mpr.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mpr-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(mpr_shims OBJECT auth.c mpr_main.c multinet.c nps.c pwcache.c wnet.c)
target_link_libraries(mpr_shims PRIVATE wine libadvapi32 libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(mpr_shims)
add_cargo_module(mpr mpr-cargo mpr.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mpr_shims psdk)
